checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: For demonstration labels, decoded IK FK must reproduce the commanded TCP in position/rotation and preserve the gripper scalar within maximum error 0.005. Rotation projection is exact for encoded rotations; joint nonuniqueness is allowed and all IK diagnostics are exposed.

contract.cut_relation: All twelve assigned [1120,1500) action ranges are retained. This includes incoming retrieval overlap [1120,1270) and outgoing insertion overlap [1380,1500). Only the Cartesian label frame changes to the causal peg anchor.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is an unnormalized Cartesian TCP target [p_peg(3 metres), R_peg_tcp first-two rotation-matrix columns(6), gripper(1)] relative to the newest causal peg_pose fixed for the sampled chunk. Slots denote t-1 through t+14; slots 1-8 execute. Decoding projects 6D orientation to SO(3), composes T_world_peg*T_peg_tcp, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. A deterministic orthogonal fallback handles only degenerate sampled 6D vectors. The native gripper scalar is passed through unchanged.
contract.parameter_semantics: No high-level numeric parameters. The caller passes an empty object. At each replan, the adapter resolves the newest observed peg_pose as the SE(3) action reference; this call is appropriate only after high-level selection judges the peg to be stably held.
